metadata.description: A collection of skills and tools for Claude Code

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Add sourced footnotes, revise prose for clarity and busy readers, strip references the reader cannot see, write controlled technical Norwegian, and lint Markdown with Vale

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: Automate browsers and Electron apps with the agent-browser CLI, pin GitHub Actions to commit SHAs on workflow edits, parallelize workflow steps, set up dependency cooldowns, Renovate, and mise toolchains, freeze install commands to their lock files, deny install-time script execution, grill a plan until its design tree holds, and pin down a project's domain terms and decisions

plugins.name: ai
plugins.description: Analyze skills, refactor references, and write documents for agents

plugins.name: other
plugins.description: Turn text, notes, code, or images into Anki flashcards built on Andy Matuschak's prompt-writing principles, and ask for a message again in plain language when it does not land
